FIELDS.NAME: The Daily Brew
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Manager, 123 Coffee Lane, Brewtown, NY 12345-6789, (555) 123-4567
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At The Daily Brew, we operate a cozy coffee shop dedicated to providing a warm ambiance for our customers to enjoy freshly brewed coffee, premium teas, and light snacks. Our establishment features seating for up to 150 patrons, allowing for a comfortable social experience. We do not serve alcohol, which helps us maintain a focus on comforting beverages and reduces any associated liability risks. 

Our team is trained in food safety practices, minimizing instances of foodborne illness while ensuring the quality of each beverage and snack served. We pride ourselves on maintaining a clean and well-organized environment, adhering to all local health, safety, and zoning regulations. Our hours of operation are continuous throughout the year, with no extended closures beyond 30 consecutive days, ensuring a consistent experience for our guests. 

Additionally, we utilize strong fire safety protocols, such as regular inspections and compliance measures, to create a safe space for everyone. Our menu frequently adjusts to incorporate seasonal offerings, maintaining an engaging experience for both regular and new customers. Overall, The Daily Brew is a welcoming coffee destination that prioritizes quality, safety, and community engagement.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Coffee Dreams LLC, a bakery and café located nearby, specializing in artisanal pastries and light lunch options.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 02/12/2023, a burst pipe in the kitchen caused significant water damage to the flooring and equipment, resulting in estimated repair costs of $8,000. The status of this claim is currently open, pending assessment by insurance. Additionally, on 05/05/2023, a coffee machine malfunctioned, causing minor burns to a staff member and resulting in medical expenses totaling $7,000. This claim has been settled and closed as of 06/10/2023.
